notes.title: Patch #4 Release Notes!
notes.notes:
Attention all Wreck Seekers!

Today we bring you another batch of fixes for Kingdom of Wreck Business!

If you find any bug, please report it in the dedicated channel here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1367040/discussions/

Changelog:
- Increased the limit of random orders from 3 to 8
- Fixed a problem with workers when extracting materials from the seabed
- Fixed the refueling of boats from locations other than the shipyard
- Minor fixes to item prices and labels

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch #3 Release Notes!
notes.notes:
Attention all Wreck Seekers!

We are back with another batch of highly requested fixes for the most critical bugs.
We hope that it will smoothen the current gameplay and we will still monitor the current situation and listen to your feedback.

If you find any bug, please report it in the dedicated channel here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1367040/discussions/


Changelog:
- Adjusted translations to match proper functions

- Added translations and prices to missing materials

- Fixed missions with U-50, U-444, Targen 1942 ships

- Fixed bug where underwater ship spawned without any texture or with missing model elements

- Object should no longer spawn floating above seabed

We would like to thank you for your constant support and passion for our game!

notes.title: Patch #2 Release Notes!
notes.notes:
Attention all Wreck Seekers!

We are thrilled to announce that thanks to your effort and support, we were able to fix some more of the critical bugs and add highly requested quality of life features.

We would like to highly encourage further discussion on the steam forum regarding any game related suggestions and bugs that you might encounter so we can look into it.

Without further ado, here are the Patch Notes:


- Added ability to set price for auctions

- Added color coding for expeditions:

 green = new
 yellow = visited mission not completed
 gray = visited mission completed

- Fixing textures/collisions on some wrecks

- Fixed a bug with the removal of the bathyscaphe after returning from an expedition

- Added light to bathyscaph, improved audio and animation

- Removed depth limit

- Fixed a bug with the wreck not showing up on the compass

- Fixed a bug with the inability to scan some wrecks

- Balance of raw material prices

- Balance of drone/bathyscaphe speed

- Extension of expiration time for expeditions

Make sure to also check our previous patch deployed last week in case you missed it :)
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1367040/announcements/detail/3648526737370105586

notes.title: Post-Launch patch is live now!
notes.notes:
Hello all Wreck Seekers!

We would like to express our gratitude to everyone who bought the game and contributed to the game by reporting bugs and adding constructive feedback - This means a lot to us!

We heard your thoughts and we deployed a patch to iron out most critical bugs found so far and implement some quality of life improvements.

Once again we want to thank you for being with us and we hope that you will have great time as we will strive to make the game as good as your expectations are!

Patch Notes:
- Fixed missing items labels

- Fixed tutorial names and descriptions

- Updated some tutorials with new texts and removed invalid ones

- Adjusted amount of money at the start of the new game - Thanks to @Blackhint, @Radar14, @DragonStryder for suggestions and feedback

- Adjusted values of mission rewards for missions

- Adjusted prices of foundable items

- Adjusted discounts at the pawnshop

- Added option to reset graphic and control settings

- Fixed bug with buttons not working when actions were reset when exiting the options panel

- Fixed soft-lock caused by refueling the ship over 100% - Thanks to @Heck if I Know for suggestions and feedback

- Fixed soft-lock on laptop when player exited on the main harbor view

- Fixed issue with counting the time required to refuel the ship

- Fixed a bug with the ability to items in the pawn shop directly from the player's inventory instead of from the warehouse

- Added the ability to change the name of a ship

- Added missing characters for the Chinese language - Thanks to @HGY1107 for the bug report

- Added missing characters for the Polish language

We will inform you about this in a separate message.

notes.title: Kingdom of Wreck Business will release on June 16th!
notes.notes:
Attention all Wreck Seekers!

After many months of hard work, we can proudly say that the development of the game is now completed.

We are very excited to finally share with you the release date of this ambitious project.

Prepare you scanners and dive right into the game on June 16th.

In order to celebrate this day properly, the game will also launch with the 10% discount at its release

There are many treasures on the ocean bed just waiting for you to find them!
